Create a Highcharts chart widget

Source: R/highcharter.R
highchart.Rd

This function creates a Highchart chart using htmlwidgets. The widget can be rendered on HTML pages generated from R Markdown, Shiny, or other applications.

Usage

highchart(
  hc_opts = list(),
  theme = getOption("highcharter.theme"),
  type = "chart",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  elementId = NULL
)

Arguments

hc_opts

A list object containing options defined as https://api.highcharts.com/highcharts/.

theme

A hc_theme class object-

type

A character value to set if use Highchart, Highstock or Highmap. Options are "chart", "stock" and "map".

width

A numeric width in pixels, or a CSS width such as "100%".

height

A numeric input in pixels.

elementId

Use an explicit element ID for the widget.

See also

hchart(), hcmap(), highchartstock()

Examples

tokyo <- subset(city_weather, city == "Tokyo")
highchart(width = "100%") |>
  hc_add_series(tokyo, "line", hcaes(date, temp_mean), name = "Tokyo") |>
  hc_xAxis(type = "datetime") |>
  hc_title(text = "Daily mean temperature in Tokyo, 2025")



# Stock navigation is available in the shared bundle.
prices <- data.frame(
  day = base::as.Date("2025-01-01") + 0:9,
  close = c(100, 102, 101, 104, 103, 106, 108, 107, 109, 112)
)
highchart(type = "stock", width = "100%") |>
  hc_add_series(prices, "line", hcaes(x = day, y = close), name = "Close")
